title: Inspection Item List
readAt: list read {time} — a source fact, not a freshness verdict

error.title: Couldn’t load the item list.
error.body: Something went wrong while loading. Nothing was changed.
error.retry: Reload the page to try again.

degradedBody: The clause list couldn’t be read. The list below still rendered; only the clause control is unavailable.

permissionsUnavailable.title: Permissions unavailable
permissionsUnavailable.body: Your configuration permissions could not be verified. Writes are disabled; retry the page.

readonly.title: View-only list
readonly.body: Your role can see item details, usage and previews. Creating an item needs a Compliance or Form Admin role. So does turning one on or off. The server and the database enforce this.

legacyNote: These older controls still work, so nothing breaks. Start any new change as a Compliance Configuration Request. This list stays the one to trust.

gov.heading: The rules for this list
gov.body: Anyone signed in can read the list. Only an admin can change it. Turning an item off keeps its history and saves a reason. An edit saves the old version first. We keep a record of every row change.

empty.title: No inspection items yet
empty.body: Items belong to regulation clauses and are reused across checklists. Add the first item above.

previewHeading: Runtime preview — what the inspector sees

audit.heading: Item history
audit.body: Open Audit on one item to see its change history. We do not give broad access to the full audit table.
audit.notFound: The selected item is no longer in the readable list.
audit.unavailable: History couldn’t load — reload to retry. This does not mean the history is empty.
audit.empty: No activity found for this item.

footer: Items belong to regulations and are reused across checklists; deactivation keeps history. Writes need the compliance or form administrator role. Every item change is logged.

form.title: Title
form.evidenceSource: Configured policy — a fixed preset, not free text.
form.duplicate: That item code already exists — codes are unique.
form.reasonNote: History is preserved; the required reason and item-row change are recorded in audit history.

preview.readonly: This shows the saved configuration only — nothing here can be edited.
preview.deactivated: This item is deactivated. It’s hidden from new checklist versions; existing history is kept.
